plugin_desc: Socomec Net Vision UPS SNMP child template for devices under Socomec PEN 4555. Interface traffic is supplied by the shared NetworkService SNMP IF-MIB floor rather than a plugin-side ifHC expansion. This child collects the SOCOMECUPS-MIB Net Vision classic tree 4555.1.1.1 only and does not mix NV7 4555.1.1.7 in the same collect path. Proven private increments are upsEstimatedChargeRemaining as ups_battery_charge_percent, upsBatteryStatus as ups_battery_status, upsOutputPercentLoad as ups_output_load_percent per line index, and optional upsBatteryVoltage as ups_battery_voltage scaled by /10 from tenths of a volt. CPU and memory scalars are not invented. iPDU proprietary identity, inlet, outlet, EMD and alarm tables are not collected in this pass. Supported brands/models - Socomec Net Vision UPS devices that expose SOCOMECUPS-MIB classic 4555.1.1.1 and standard IF-MIB.
name: NetworkService

metrics.name: ups_battery_charge_percent
metrics.description: Estimated battery charge remaining in percent from SOCOMECUPS-MIB upsEstimatedChargeRemaining (1.3.6.1.4.1.4555.1.1.1.1.2.4) on the Net Vision classic tree. The SNMP value is already a percentage.

metrics.name: ups_battery_status
metrics.description: Battery status from SOCOMECUPS-MIB upsBatteryStatus (1.3.6.1.4.1.4555.1.1.1.1.2.1) on the Net Vision classic tree. Values follow the MIB enumeration unknown(1), batteryNormal(2), batteryLow(3) and batteryDepleted(4).

metrics.name: ups_output_load_percent
metrics.description: Per-line output percent load from SOCOMECUPS-MIB upsOutputPercentLoad (1.3.6.1.4.1.4555.1.1.1.1.4.4.1.4) with upsOutputLineIndex (1.3.6.1.4.1.4555.1.1.1.1.4.4.1.1) on the Net Vision classic tree. The SNMP value is already a percentage. Empty output-line tables yield no rows.

metrics.name: ups_battery_voltage
metrics.description: Battery voltage in volts from SOCOMECUPS-MIB upsBatteryVoltage (1.3.6.1.4.1.4555.1.1.1.1.2.5) on the Net Vision classic tree. The SNMP value is tenths of a volt, so the query divides by 10.

metrics.name: interface_ifHCInOctets
metrics.description: This metric indicates the average rate of inbound bytes received over the past 5 minutes, based on the 64-bit ifHCInOctets counter which does not wrap on high-speed interfaces.

metrics.name: interface_ifHCOutOctets
metrics.description: This metric indicates the average rate of outbound bytes sent over the past 5 minutes, based on the 64-bit ifHCOutOctets counter which does not wrap on high-speed interfaces.

metrics.name: snmp_uptime
metrics.description: This metric indicates the uptime of the device since the last restart. By monitoring the uptime, network administrators can understand the stability and reliability of the device and identify potential reboot or failure issues.
